subject: Coord: BlueHarbour demo — multi-stakeholder availability and IT pre-check
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@blueharbour.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Nina Petrova <nina.petrova@blueharbour.com>, it-security@blueharbour.com
Date: Wed, Apr 28, 2027 at 08:15 AM PDT
Subject: Demo request — self-serve signup (BlueHarbour) — coordination

Hi Marissa,

We just completed a self-serve signup and would like a live demo focused on SSO (SAML) and networking for our AWS region (eu-west-1). Our core attendees will be: me (Product), Nina (IT lead), and our security alias for policy questions.

Preferred windows (CEST) next week: Tue 10:00–11:30, Wed 14:00–16:00, Thu 09:00–11:00. We are based in Dublin (CEST).

I attached the network whitelist doc that the procurement team requested — can you confirm if we'll need additional firewall openings for the demo environment? Attachment: network_whitelist_requirements.pdf

Thanks,
Liam O'Connor
Product Manager
BlueHarbour Systems
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@blueharbour.com>
Cc: Nina Petrova <nina.petrova@blueharbour.com>, it-security@blueharbour.com, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, Apr 28, 2027 at 10:45 AM PDT
Subject: Re: Demo request — self-serve signup (BlueHarbour) — coordination

Hi Liam — great to meet you (virtually) and welcome to Redwood.

Thanks for the whitelist doc — that helps. Quick notes and a proposed approach:
- We recommend a 45–60 minute demo with a 20-minute technical pre-call for your IT/security to validate the network setup.
- I'll join for the intro and product flow; Karthik (AE) will cover pricing/rollout and next steps; Soojin (SE) will lead the SSO/network deep-dive. Grace (our SDR) will do a warm handoff and send calendar invites.

Suggested slots (converted):
- Tue 10:30–11:30 CEST (Mon 01:30–02:30 PDT)
- Wed 14:30–15:30 CEST (Wed 05:30–06:30 PDT) — preferred for SE availability
- Thu 09:00–10:00 CEST (Wed 00:00–01:00 PDT)

Can you confirm a single best slot (and whether your security alias can join the pre-call ~20 minutes before)? If Wed 14:30 CEST works, we'll schedule the 20-minute IT pre-call at 14:10 CEST and the demo at 14:30.

Assignees: Marissa (owner), Karthik (AE), Soojin (SE), Grace (calendar).

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Enterprise SDR Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Nina Petrova <nina.petrova@blueharbour.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@blueharbour.com>

Hi Marissa & Liam,

Thanks — Wed 14:30–15:30 CEST works best for the IT team. We'll need the SE to cover network egress ranges and any temporary ports for the demo. Also please include a short segment on our data retention questions — specifically how long logs persist in demo environments vs production.

We confirm the security alias can join both the pre-call and the demo: it-security@blueharbour.com.

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, Apr 29, 2027 at 09:30 AM PDT
Subject: Re: Demo request — technical pre-call checklist and SE notes

Hi team — looping in some quick technical guidance ahead of the pre-call. Attachment: technical_precall_checklist.docx (short checklist for ports, SAML metadata, and test account).

Key items for IT to confirm during the 20-minute pre-call:
- Allow outbound to *.redwood-inference.com on ports 443 and 3478 (STUN) for media fallback.
- Ensure SAML IdP metadata (entityID + ACS URL) is available; we'll test a staging SSO flow.
- If you have strict egress IP allowlists, we can provide per-region IP ranges; otherwise the whitelist doc you sent is usually sufficient for demos.

If the pre-call reveals a need for temporary VPN access, we can set a 30-minute window — please flag that early.
